scenarios.title: With the actual Expo phone shell paired to an isolated desktop, open Tasks > Create Workspace with the software keyboard visible at narrow width; scroll to all fields/actions, cancel, then open filters. Header and content return to bounds and no sheet/action is clipped. Requires a real phone/simulator; desktop browser proof does not establish this.

On the paired native phone, copy a file path/review notes/task link through the granted clipboard action, then open a task external link in the OS browser and return to the same host/worktree without losing panel state. Use only temporary owned repository/provider fixtures.

Enable direct foreground notifications on a paired phone, leave and return to the app, and verify subscription cleanup/reconnect, no duplicated alert and correct focused-workspace suppression. Background APNs/FCM banners are not supported by this direct subscription and must not be represented as delivered.
